During an experiment, the salinity of an aquarium was recorded to the nearest integer at certain times. The scatterplot shows the recorded salinity $y$, in parts per thousand (ppt), of the aquarium water $x$ hours after the start of the experiment.

What was the average rate of change, in ppt per hour, of the recorded salinity from $x = 1$ to $x = 4$?

The average rate of change is
{{field-1}} $ppt/hour$.

![](images/26/26b4dcd4e26437398c6ff758d4805cc35998a3b02f86c2985b7ffeae4fe57e3b.png)

During an experiment, the air pressure in a tire was recorded to the nearest integer at certain times. The scatterplot shows the recorded pressure $y$, in kilopascals (kPa), of the tire $x$ seconds after the start of the experiment.

What was the average rate of change, in kPa per second, of the recorded pressure from $x = 2$ to $x = 6$?

The average rate of change is
{{field-1}} $kPa/second$.
